datasets.name: ODSPAccidentR
datasets.sql: select PINS_FullMotor.returnName(kli_id) as name,Pins_FullMotor.returnAddress(kli_id) as Address,Pins_FullMotor.returnPhone(kli_id) as phone,pins_fullmotor.returnFax(kli_id) as fax,c.*from ins_grouppersonalaccident c  where c.id=:id AND CLOSE_PREFIX=0

datasets.name: ODSPAccident
datasets.sql: select PINS_FullMotor.returnName(pacc.kli_id) as name,pacc.rowid,pacc.*,ic.begin_date,ic.end_date from ins_grouppersonalaccident pacc,ins_contracts ic where ic.blank_id=pacc.id and ic.type_id=3 and pacc.close_prefix=0 order by pacc.:id

datasets.name: ODSCustomers
datasets.sql: select c.rowid,c.id,c.name||' '||c.surname||' '||c.fathername as name,c.address,c.mobilephone,c.fax from ins_customers c

datasets.name: Risks
datasets.sql: select idr.rowid, idr.* from ins_dict_risks idr

datasets.name: ODSPAccSuggest
datasets.sql:
select  s.rowid,s.* from ins_pacc_suggestion s
where paid = :paid

datasets.name: ODSContracts
datasets.sql:
select ic.rowid, ic.* from ins_contracts ic
where blank_id = :blankid
and type_id = 3

datasets.name: ODSAgent
datasets.sql: select id,(name||' '||surname||' '||fathername) as name from ins_agents

datasets.name: ODSCustomers
datasets.sql: select c.rowid,c.id,c.name||' '||c.surname||' '||c.fathername as name,c.address,c.mobilephone,c.fax from ins_customers c
